remarks: Opportunity Knocks in Stamford's Belltown Neighborhood. Located on a spacious corner lot, this 4-bedroom, 3-bath single-family home offers a classic layout, ideal to move in now and have the opportunity to renovate at your own pace. The main level features a living room with a wood-burning fireplace and built-ins, wood floors, dining room, office and family room with full bath, adjacent kitchen with access to garden. Upstairs, you'll find four bedrooms and two additional full baths. The basement with laundry and ample storage, detached two car garage. Whether you're looking to customize your space or an investor seeking value in a prime location, this home presents a great opportunity to build equity in one of Stamford's established neighborhoods. Bring your vision and make it your own!
